name: webshell-js-sdk
description: This SDK in javascript is the easiest way to use Webshell client side

paragraphs: Webshell helps developers to integrate APIs in their apps in a simple way. You send us some javascript via HTTP and we send you back some JSON with all APIs responses you've requested.
